outcome: Umbilical cord blood creatine kinase MB (CK-MB) levels
Umbilical cord blood troponin T (TnT-hs) levels
Umbilical cord blood pro-brain natriuretic peptide (proBNP) levels
Umbilical cord blood ischaemia modified albumin (IMA) levels

Fetal cardiac function (cardiothoracic index, left sphericity index, left myocardial performance index (MPI), tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion (TAPSE), mitral annular plane systolic excursion (MAPSE))
cohort: The study included 39 pregnant women with IUGR (diagnosed with estimated fetal weight < 10th percentile) and 42 healthy pregnant women in a control group.
finding: IUGR was associated with fetal cardiac morphological changes (higher cardiothoracic index, lower left sphericity index), systolic dysfunction (higher MPI, lower TAPSE and MAPSE), and increased umbilical cord blood proBNP levels, with proBNP negatively correlated with MAPSE.
cross-section timing: Third trimester of pregnancy for fetal cardiac function evaluation and at birth for umbilical cord blood biochemical tests.
birth_weight: IUGR was defined as estimated fetal weight < 10th percentile, but specific birth weight ranges for the cohort were not provided.
